0022600022.text: The Timberwolves (3-2, 1-1 at home) host the Clippers (1-2, 1-0 at home) in Minnesota's sixth game of the 2026-27 season and a West Group B Emirates NBA Cup regular-season game. Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, and 6th in the West, and is on a two-game losing streak, while Los Angeles is 4th in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, 12th in the West, and also on a two-game losing streak. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Los Angeles is missing Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), Max Strus (out, plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (out, quadriceps soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on March 11, 2026 in Los Angeles, where Minnesota lost 153-128.
